method_checks.no_hard_gate_or_economic_goal_change: Original goals unchanged and diagnostic states, intervals or direction do not silently become acceptance rules.

conditions_to_verify_after_lock: Final locked design bytes must equal the reviewed SHA, or explicitly review subsequent changes before outcomes are computed.
Actual implementation must restrict feature inputs to D-known date/ret20/index states and planned posture, and source identity/usecols must exclude inherited future labels.
Verify full 2020-2025 official catalogue coverage/page identity, exact title inventory, duplicate handling and publication date fields before asserting W0; do not use PDF signature dates.
Verify W UNKNOWN independently for nine initial D sessions and first E; retain all dates and original PnL, and exclude 2026 from W-effect population.
PAST-year reference means calendar years strictly earlier than each target year; all OTHER-year references may include later history only as explicitly retrospective descriptions.

Freeze original common state/posture support and min-count weights for pooled comparisons. For episode deletions that remove a required group, retain null/support failure rather than silently switching cells or weights.
Keep all years, all supported and unsupported cells, actual PLAN_BUY unfilled orders, all original announcement episodes, and both raw and fixed pooled contrasts; no favorable episode deletion.
Check sparse W/PLAN_BUY and cross-year support explicitly; lack of overlap is not evidence of ineffectiveness or permission to add a new model.

Independently reconcile actual daily accounting, HOLD decomposition, state assignment, W dates, cross-year reference means and every episode deletion after root announces the locked outputs are ready.
research_interpretation: This can distinguish descriptive annual-loss locations and whether a fixed prior observable posture/state has recurring or opposing outcomes elsewhere. It cannot identify a unique causal driver, prove that filtering an order improves a continuous account, or repair original annual targets by summing old PnL.
